wire.t: Friday's final report has Mike Evans and Marvin Harrison Jr. both ruled Out, and both are still in the Jefferson’s Reserve starting lineup. Bhayshul Tuten has no game status and should play.

jrsmith1391 added Cowboys tight end Brevyn Spann-Ford and dropped Kalif Raymond Friday night, then put Spann-Ford in the Catfan94’s Farm Team lineup. T.J. Hockenson is Out and Colston Loveland is on Chicago's bye.
Spann-Ford signed an extension in September that keeps him in Dallas through 2029. Jake Ferguson, the Cowboys' starter, is on the Kraft for Cash IR.

Questionable starters for Sunday: Amon-Ra St. Brown and Kenneth Walker III (Catfan94’s Farm Team), Garrett Wilson (The Champ), Denzel Boston (StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte), Rhamondre Stevenson (Dude, Your Getting a Dell), Omar Cooper Jr. and Jordan Addison (OBJAY), and Adonai Mitchell (I Chase Brown Kids).

Cleared with no game status: Tony Pollard (Bourbon Lover), Ladd McConkey (Asian Jim), Jakobi Meyers and Chris Rodriguez Jr. (StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte), Jonathan Taylor (Kraft for Cash) and George Pickens (LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix).
Kyler Murray was ruled Out. He's on the Asian Jim bench, so ManicOrientals doesn't have to move anything.

Washington beat the Giants 24-21 Thursday night, and Stefon Diggs caught the winning 32-yard touchdown from Jayden Daniels with 57 seconds left. Diggs scored 17.8 for Dude, Your Getting a Dell, which is already 22% of Br0phy's season average.

Isaiah Likely had 9 catches for 127 yards and a 66-yard touchdown, 29.7 points for LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix. J.J. McCarthy threw for 293 yards and scored 22.12 on the Jefferson’s Reserve bench. jmello16 starts C.J. Stroud on Sunday.

stories.title: Jefferson’s Reserve has two starters ruled Out, and not one healthy receiver left on the bench
stories.dek: Mike Evans and Marvin Harrison Jr. are both Out. Catfan94’s Farm Team grabs Brevyn Spann-Ford off waivers to cover a tight end hole.
body: Friday's final injury report ruled out Mike Evans and Marvin Harrison Jr., and as of this morning both are still in the Jefferson’s Reserve lineup. That's not a jmello16 screwup yet. The games are Sunday and the report came out Friday afternoon. But it's a real problem, because the bench doesn't have an answer.

Look at the active bench: Chris Godwin Jr. is on Tampa Bay's bye, Jaylen Waddle is Out, and there isn't another healthy receiver there. Chris Olave can slide from flex to receiver, and Kyle Pitts Sr. or Emanuel Wilson can take the flex, but the third receiver spot needs a body. jmello16 either promotes Elic Ayomanor, Chimere Dike or Ja'Kobi Lane off the taxi squad or hits free agency.

And this is against LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix, which already leads 29.70 to 0.00 and is now a 46.4-point favorite, up from 43.4. J.J. McCarthy's 22.12 is still sitting on the bench from Thursday. Bhayshul Tuten did get cleared, so there's that.

Meanwhile jrsmith1391 actually handled it. T.J. Hockenson was ruled Out and Colston Loveland is on Chicago's bye, so Catfan94’s Farm Team picked up Brevyn Spann-Ford, dropped Kalif Raymond, and started him. Spann-Ford got an extension through 2029 in September, and Jake Ferguson is on the Kraft for Cash IR. Down 28.70 to OBJAY, still a 25.6-point favorite. That's how you manage a Friday.

stories.title: Eight starters are Questionable, and Catfan94’s Farm Team has two of them
stories.dek: Tony Pollard, Jakobi Meyers, Chris Rodriguez Jr. and Ladd McConkey all got cleared. Check your lineups before 1 PM.
body: The questionable list for Sunday starters: Amon-Ra St. Brown and Kenneth Walker III for Catfan94’s Farm Team, Garrett Wilson for The Champ, Denzel Boston for StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte, Rhamondre Stevenson for Dude, Your Getting a Dell, Omar Cooper Jr. and Jordan Addison for OBJAY, and Adonai Mitchell for I Chase Brown Kids.

jrsmith1391 has MarShawn Lloyd and Zonovan Knight on the bench, since Bucky Irving and D'Andre Swift are on bye. JAY2913 has Efton Chism III and Tutu Atwell (Emeka Egbuka is on Tampa Bay's bye). ZachCarroll09 has Troy Franklin, who's on Denver's bye, and Rashod Bateman. TJohn91 has Kayshon Boutte and Keenan Allen.

Good news for some people: Tony Pollard got cleared for Bourbon Lover after missing Thursday, and Ladd McConkey has no status for Asian Jim. Jakobi Meyers and Chris Rodriguez Jr. are good to go for me.

My one question mark is Denzel Boston. If he's out, I've got Devaughn Vele, Konata Mumpfield and Ashton Dulin on the bench. I'm a 38.2-point underdog to Hold My DK, down from 41.2, so it barely matters, but I'm going to manage it anyway, because apparently that's my brand now.

stories.title: J.J. McCarthy drops 22.12 on the Jefferson’s Reserve bench, and Bill_Buttlicker finally benches Makai Lemon
stories.dek: Washington wins 24-21 on a Stefon Diggs touchdown with 57 seconds left. OBJAY, I Chase Brown Kids and LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix bank the points.
body: Washington beat the Giants 24-21, and the best fantasy performance wasn't in anybody's lineup on the team that needed it. J.J. McCarthy threw for 293 yards and scored 22.12 on the Jefferson’s Reserve bench. That's two weeks in a row: C.J. Stroud had 50.36 on the bench in Week 9, so jmello16 started Stroud this week, and now the other one went off. Stroud plays Sunday, so this one isn't over, but Jefferson’s Reserve is down 29.7 to 0.00 to LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix before kickoff.
That 29.7 is Isaiah Likely, who had 9 catches, 127 yards and a 66-yard touchdown. Catfan94 is 8‑1, a 43.4-point favorite, and got a head start from his tight end. Must be nice.

OBJAY got 28.7 from Cam Skattebo and his two touchdowns, so JAY2913 leads Catfan94’s Farm Team 28.70 to 0.00. Antonio Williams also caught a 31-yard touchdown for Washington and scored 11.7 on OBJAY's taxi squad. I Chase Brown Kids leads Bourbon Lover 33.16 to 0.30 behind Jayden Daniels (27.76, three touchdowns, two picks). Devin Singletary got one carry. Dude, Your Getting a Dell got 17.8 from Stefon Diggs, including the winning touchdown, and leads The Champ 17.80 to 0.00. Br0phy is 0‑9 and has a lead. Screenshot it.

And yes, I fixed it. Makai Lemon is out of the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte lineup, Chris Rodriguez Jr. and AJ Barner are in, and the league has zero bye-week starters. I'm still a 41.2-point underdog to Hold My DK, Denzel Boston didn't practice Thursday, and Kaleb Johnson and Ashton Dulin are still on my bench. Baby steps.

stories.title: Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks, and four contenders own none
stories.dek: The picks through 2029 are lopsided, and the standings are too.
body: Counting 2027 through 2029, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte owns 12 first-round picks, which is a full first round's worth of picks. JAY2913 is next with six on OBJAY, then ZachCarroll09 with five on I Chase Brown Kids and Br0phy with four on Dude, Your Getting a Dell.

Kraft for Cash, Catfan94’s Farm Team, LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and Hold My DK own zero first-round picks over that stretch, and they are the top four teams in the standings. That's a bet on now, and it's working while the whole group is 6‑3 or better.
The risk is that all four teams are on the wrong side of a rebuild in three years, and the one with 12 first-round picks is 3‑6 with 27-72 all-play. Tyler's plan is a long one.

columns.title: Five quarterbacks is not a strategy, jmello16
columns.dek: Jefferson’s Reserve has left 72.48 points on the bench at quarterback in two weeks.
body: I'll be fair to jmello16 first. Starting C.J. Stroud this week after he put up 50.36 is a defensible call. Stroud plays Sunday and could still outscore J.J. McCarthy's 22.12. Nobody gets fired over a Thursday.

But here's the number: 50.36 in Week 9 and 22.12 in Week 10. That's 72.48 points at quarterback on the bench over two weeks. In superflex you're supposed to start two of these guys, and Jefferson’s Reserve keeps guessing on which two.

Five quarterbacks on one roster is a hoarding problem, not depth. Trade one. Asian Jim has Kyler Murray missing practice. Somebody in this league will pay for a 23-year-old who just threw for 293 yards.
Mike Evans and Bhayshul Tuten didn't practice Thursday either. Read the Friday report, set the lineup, and quit leaving points in the parking lot.

columns.title: 5 Saturday lineup tips from Holden McGroin, who has never once checked an injury report
columns.dek: It's the day before kickoff. Holden is relaxed. Too relaxed.
body: 1. Leave Out players in your lineup. Mike Evans and Marvin Harrison Jr. are both Out, which means nobody can tackle them. Jefferson’s Reserve is currently testing this.
2. Never pick up a free agent on a Friday night. jrsmith1391 grabbed Brevyn Spann-Ford at 9:53 PM. Nothing good happens after 9 PM, except replacing an Out tight end with a healthy one, I guess.

3. Five quarterbacks is the right number. You can't start them all, but you can look at them. jmello16 has two on the active bench, one on the taxi squad and zero healthy receivers on the bench. Balance.
4. Trust the questionable tag. Questionable means the player has questions. Answer them. Eight starters are Questionable this week, so that's a lot of homework.
5. Be like Bill_Buttlicker and get 3 points better on Friday. At this pace he'll be favored by Week 23.

columns.title: Jefferson’s Reserve has 80% more quarterbacks than healthy bench receivers, which is infinity
columns.dek: Ivana ran the numbers on Friday's report. She regrets nothing.
body: Jefferson’s Reserve has five quarterbacks on the roster and zero healthy receivers on the active bench. Five divided by zero is infinity, so by my model Jefferson’s Reserve is infinitely deep. At the wrong position.

Two of the nine Jefferson’s Reserve starters are Out. That's 22.2% of the lineup. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix leads 29.70 to 0.00, which is a lead of 29.7 times nothing, also infinity. That's two infinities in one matchup. I've never seen anything like it.

Catfan94’s Farm Team dropped Kalif Raymond and added Brevyn Spann-Ford, whose extension runs through 2029. That's three more years of Spann-Ford, or 1,095 days, or roughly 26,280 hours of jrsmith1391 having a tight end. My model says that's a lot of hours.

Bill_Buttlicker's spread went from 41.2 to 38.2, a 7.3% improvement. Compound that weekly and StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte becomes the favorite in 13 weeks. The regular season has five weeks left, counting this one. The model is still bullish.

exits.t: One of five quarterbacks on the Jefferson’s Reserve roster, on a roster with no healthy receiver behind its starters. Would like to be traded to anyone who needs a quarterback instead of a fifth one.
Caught a 31-yard touchdown Thursday and scored 11.7 on OBJAY's taxi squad, where points don't count. Wants a roster spot that counts.
Scored 14.3 on the bench in Week 9 and is still on the bench in Week 10, even after Bill_Buttlicker finally fixed the bye-week spot. Wants a manager who checks the depth chart.
Scored 14.4 on the bench in a 6.28-point loss in Week 9, and he's on the bench again with Emeka Egbuka and Luther Burden III on bye.
Scored 29.5 on the bench in Week 9 and still isn't starting for The Champ. Wants a team that reads its own box scores.
Scored 16.48 on the bench in Week 9 behind Josh Allen and Jordan Love. Wants a starting job somewhere, preferably on a team without two better quarterbacks.
